tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere: the web reader, onboarding and every PDF page. Warm newsprint, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, the sticky reader header, popovers and the floating feedback bar. Use sparingly; most content sits flat on paper divided by rules.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Image placeholders, skeleton loaders, the progress-bar track and hover fills on ghost controls.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline column rules and dividers between stories. Decorative only; never the sole border of an interactive control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips and secondary buttons (3:1 or better on paper and paper-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy, the masthead and heavy rules, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and highlight. Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Decks (standfirsts) and story summaries on paper and paper-raised: a step quieter than headlines.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: source, reading time, datelines, captions, read headlines. On paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: the primary button label and selected topic chips.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Press red, the one brand accent: kickers, breaking/developing labels, the active nav item, the accent button. As text on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and press-soft.

tokens.name: press-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind press text: the Breaking badge, form error messages.

tokens.name: on-press
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a press fill (the accent button). Dark in the night theme because press lightens there.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: Editor's-pen blue: everything about personalization and learning. Why-this tags, More-like-this active state, links, focus ring. As text on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and pen-soft.

tokens.name: pen-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind pen text: pressed feedback buttons, the 'Picked for you' strip.

tokens.name: on-pen
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pen fill.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marker highlight behind ink text: reader highlights and the key phrase in a takeaway. Never behind muted or colored text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in summaries and settings. Alias of pen, underlined.

families.sans: "Libre Franklin", "Franklin Gothic Medium", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Masthead
groups.note: Blackletter is the wordmark and nothing else.

styles.name: masthead
styles.usage: The nameplate on the front page, onboarding welcome and PDF page 1. Drop to 44px under 640px wide.

styles.name: masthead-sm
styles.usage: Compact sticky header, edition cards in the archive, PDF running heads.

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: Newsreader with optical sizing; tighter tracking as size grows.

styles.name: headline-xl
styles.sample: The quiet race to build a cheaper battery
styles.usage: The lead story only, one per edition. 36px/40px under 640px.

styles.name: headline-lg
styles.usage: Second-rank stories, onboarding step titles, page titles (Archive, Settings).

styles.name: headline-md
styles.sample: Central bank holds rates for a third month
styles.usage: Standard story cards in the section grid.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Briefs, compact lists, edition card headlines, takeaway items.

styles.name: deck
styles.sample: Three labs say sodium cells could undercut lithium by 2028.
styles.usage: The standfirst under a lead or second-rank headline, in ink-soft.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.sample: We are not short of news. We are short of attention.
styles.usage: Pull quotes between rules, at most one per section.

styles.name: body-text
styles.sample: Researchers in three countries published results this week suggesting that sodium could replace lithium in grid storage.
styles.usage: AI summaries and long reading text. Keep lines under the measure token (about 68 characters).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Sodium is cheaper and more plentiful, but heavier per kilowatt-hour.
styles.usage: Story card summaries and brief text, in ink-soft.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Libre Franklin, the newspaper sans. Kicker and dateline are set uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Section or topic label above a headline, in press. Uppercase.

styles.name: dateline
styles.usage: Masthead ears and strip, step counters, archive dates. Uppercase, ink-muted or ink.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Form labels, section header titles, chip text.

styles.name: ui-text
styles.sample: Pick at least three topics. You can change these any time.
styles.usage: Interface copy: onboarding help text, settings, empty states.

styles.name: ui-button
styles.usage: Button labels.

styles.name: ui-meta
styles.usage: Story metadata, Why-this tags, captions.

groups.name: Print (PDF)
groups.note: CSS px for an A4 page rendered at 96dpi (Playwright page.pdf). 12.5px is about 9.4pt, broadsheet body size.

styles.name: print-lead
styles.sample: The quiet race to build a cheaper battery
styles.usage: Lead headline on PDF page 1, spanning 3–4 columns.

styles.name: print-headline
styles.usage: Column story headlines in the PDF.

styles.name: print-body
styles.sample: Researchers in three countries published results this week.
styles.usage: PDF column text, justified with hyphens: auto.

styles.name: print-kicker
styles.usage: PDF kickers and section heads, uppercase in press.

spacing.note: 4px base. Stories breathe vertically; columns are separated by gutter plus a rule.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, kicker-to-headline gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Headline-to-deck gap, inside chips, between meta items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a story's text and its meta row; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, between briefs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between stories in a column; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile; onboarding block gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above the masthead; page top padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: End-of-paper footer spacing.

radius.note: Print is square. Rounding is reserved for things you tap.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Story cards, images, boxes, every PDF element.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, the floating feedback bar, edition cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Topic chips and the Why-this tag only.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Only floating things get one.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating feedback bar, popovers, the sticky header once scrolled.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px paper gap then 2px solid pen (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).

layout.note: The page grid for the web reader.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of reading text (about 68 characters of body-text).

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the front page grid.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Column gap; a 1px rule sits in the middle of it.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: Thick rule under the masthead and above section headers.
